subject: Packaging options and recommended tier shift for CarePoint
messages:
From: Joanna Sullivan <joanna.sullivan@carepoint.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: ethan.m@carepoint.com, procurement@carepoint.com
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Packaging question — right-sizing for Q1 pilot and 2027 scale

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency profiles and the KV caching behavior. We have two related asks as we prepare an internal recommendation for our steering committee:

1) We expect to run a 3-month pilot (Q1) with ~50k monthly generation requests (typical prompt length ~220 tokens, expected average response ~120 tokens) and then scale to ~1.2M/month in H2 2027. What packaging path do you recommend to move from a low-commit pilot to predictable, cost-efficient production (reserved capacity vs. metered hosted)?

2) Feature bundling — we need: streaming responses for clinician chat, per-route observability, and audit logs retained for 12 months (HIPAA-adjacent). Which plan(s) include these vs. add-ons, and can you outline any tier upgrade penalties or prorations?

Also: procurement will ask about potential one-time onboarding credits or pilot discounts, and whether a dedicated capacity pilot is possible in our east US region.

Can you put together a short options matrix we can share? We need something concise for next Thursday's committee meeting (Oct 22).

Best,
Joanna
Director of Product
CarePoint Health

--
Attachment: carepoint_pilot_scope.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Joanna Sullivan <joanna.sullivan@carepoint.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Packaging question — right-sizing for Q1 pilot and 2027 scale

Hi Joanna — great to meet the team yesterday, and thanks for the clear scope. High level answer up front: start on hosted with a committed pilot credit + optional Dedicated pilot for performance validation, then move to a Reserved (Dedicated) contract when you hit predictable throughput in H2.

Quick bullets for the committee (I can turn this into a one-pager):
- Pilot (Q1): Hosted API + pilot credit (30–60 days). We can attach a temporary committed-credit bundle that gives a ~20% effective discount against list for the pilot volume. No long-term penalty; credits simply apply to usage.
- Performance validation (optional): 2–4 week Dedicated pilot (east US), provisioned as a short-term reserved node pool — ideal if you need guaranteed latency/SLOs for clinician-facing flows. We can waive the Dedicated pilot setup fee as part of the negotiation.
- Production (H2): Reserved (monthly commit) for unit economics at scale. We recommend a blended approach: reserved capacity sized for baseline sustained throughput + burst on Hosted for spikes.

Feature bundling / observability: streaming and per-route observability are included at the Platform and Dedicated tiers respectively; 12-month audit log retention is an add-on (privacy/compliance pack). I flagged karthik to confirm the technical retention details and whether any export tooling is needed for your compliance team.

I'll assemble a concise options matrix and pass to Ben for pricing scenarios. If you can share a simple monthly usage profile (spike days, percent of streaming vs. sync requests), that will let us size the reserved pool more accurately.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference

--

Subject: CarePoint — packaging scenarios and provisional pricing (pilot -> reserved)

Joanna / Vanessa — attaching two quick scenarios and a line-item quote. TL;DR: two paths with comparable cost after 6–9 months; choice depends on how much risk you want to push to Redwood.

Attachments: CarePoint_Redwood_Options_v1.pdf, quote_CP-2026-1473.xlsx

Scenario A — Hosted-first (lower up-front commitment)\- Pilot credit: $18k one-time credit applied to first 60 days (covers estimated Q1 hosted usage based on your numbers).\- Post-pilot: pay-as-you-go with committed 6-month minimum for a 12% sliding discount; no Dedicated setup.\- Observability: Per-route analytics included; 12-month audit log is a $3k/month add-on.

Scenario B — Dedicated-validated (higher early commit, lower unit cost later)\- 2-month Dedicated pilot (waived setup): $12k refundable staging deposit, applied to future reserved commit if converted.\- Reserved commit for H2: monthly committed capacity blocks priced at an estimated $0.015 per generation-token at target scale (locked for 12 months).\- Observability & retention: Included in Dedicated enterprise bundle; compliance pack available for extended export (one-time integration fee $8k).

Discounts / pilot credits: We can do a one-off commercial concession on the onboarding fee (up to 50%) for mid-market pilots if you commit to a 12-month reserved conversion trigger. I put that as a negotiable line in the spreadsheet.

Next steps:
1) Joanna — tell us your expected daily peak (tokens/min) and % of requests that will use streaming.
2) Ben/Vanessa — we’ll produce a 1-page options matrix for Oct 22.

Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Joanna / Procurement team — attaching the one-page matrix (see link in HubSpot deal and attached PDF/quote). Below is the recommended, committee-friendly summary and a short mutual action plan so your steering committee can see timing and gating items at a glance.

Executive summary (one line): Start hosted with a pilot credit and optional Dedicated validation; convert to a 12-month reserved commit in H2 2027 when usage stabilizes for best unit economics.

Options snapshot:
- Pilot (hosted + credit): fastest time-to-value, minimal ops, pilot credit covers initial consumption. No penalties; credits expire after 60 days.
- Dedicated validation: recommended if clinician SLOs must be guaranteed during pilot. We can provide east US nodes for the 2–4 week window; setup fee waived with the pilot concession.
- Reserved commit (12 months): best cost-per-token at scale; recommend blended routing to handle spikes.

Pricing & commercial concessions:
- Pilot credit: $18k (one-time)
- Dedicated staging deposit: $12k refundable on conversion
- Compliance pack for 12-month log retention: $3k/month if on hosted; included in Dedicated enterprise bundle (or one-time export integration $8k)
- Onboarding fee: 50% waiver possible if you convert to Reserved within 9 months

Minimal mutual action plan for Oct 22 committee (3 items):
1) CarePoint to confirm pilot scope doc (we reviewed the spreadsheet you attached) — owner: Joanna — due Oct 20
2) Redwood to provide a signed pilot SOW & the quick-quote (DocuSign link) — owner: Vanessa/Ben — due Oct 21
3) Technical validation call if you choose Dedicated pilot (provisioning window & test plan) — owner: Karthik — schedule by Oct 21

If that all looks good I’ll send the DocuSign package for the pilot credit and the refundable staging deposit. Happy to compress timelines if your committee wants faster turnaround.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Exec | Redwood Inference
